name: Cochin Monsoon Open 2018

venue.name: Shikshak Sadan
venue.address: Shikshak Sadan, Karikkamuri Rd, Karikkamuri, Ernakulam South, Ernakulam, Kerala 682011

information:
The winner of 3x3x3 One-Handed will be declared as the winner of the competition.
There is no on-spot registration.
Participation limit is 50, so register as soon as possible.
Registration closes either on Aug 10, 2018, 11:59 PM IST or when registration count reaches 50 (whichever comes first)
[Click here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CochinMonsoonOpen2018/register) to register.
